c.v: Both ESP32-S3's flash and SRAM can be further split to achieve more flexible permission control.
Each split region can be configured with different access independently.
Flash can be split into 4 regions, the length of each should be the integral multiples of
SRAM can be split into 4 regions, the length of each should be the integral multiples of
Also, the starting address of each region should also be aligned to
The following registers can be used to configure how the flash or SRAM are split.
